1.consolidated_definition: Persona que se caracteriza por su esfuerzo, valentía y bondad, según lo registra el cronista Gonzalo Fernández de Oviedo.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Person who is characterized by their effort, bravery, and kindness, as recorded by the chronicler Gonzalo Fernández de Oviedo.
